python - <<'PY'
import contextlib
import io
import operator
import semver

v = semver.VersionInfo('1', '2', '3', 4, 5)
assert tuple(v) == (1, 2, 3, '4', '5')
for name in ('major', 'minor', 'patch', 'prerelease', 'build'):
    for change in (lambda: setattr(v, name, 9), lambda: delattr(v, name)):
        try:
            change()
        except AttributeError:
            pass
        else:
            raise AssertionError(name + ' is mutable')

v = semver.VersionInfo.parse('1.2.3-rc.9+build.9')
for op, expected in ((operator.eq, True), (operator.ne, False),
                     (operator.lt, False), (operator.le, True),
                     (operator.gt, False), (operator.ge, True)):
    assert op(v, tuple(v)) is expected
    assert op(tuple(v), v) is expected
assert v < (2, 0, 0)
assert (1, 2, 3) > v
assert v == (1, 2, 3, 'rc.9', 'ignored-build')
for other in ('1.2.3', 1):
    assert v != other
    for op in (operator.lt, operator.le, operator.gt, operator.ge):
        try:
            op(v, other)
        except TypeError:
            pass
        else:
            raise AssertionError('unsupported comparison')

expected = {'major': '2.0.0', 'minor': '1.3.0', 'patch': '1.2.4',
            'prerelease': '1.2.3-rc.10', 'build': '1.2.3-rc.9+build.10'}
for part, result in expected.items():
    bumped = getattr(v, 'bump_' + part)()
    assert isinstance(bumped, semver.VersionInfo)
    assert str(bumped) == result
assert str(v) == '1.2.3-rc.9+build.9'
assert str(v.replace(major='2', prerelease=None)) == '2.2.3+build.9'
assert semver.replace(str(v), build=None) == '1.2.3-rc.9'
assert v.replace() is not v
try:
    v.replace(unknown=1)
except TypeError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('unknown replacement accepted')
for argv, output, status in [(['bump', 'major', '1.2.3'], '2.0.0\n', 0),
                             (['compare', '1.0.0', '2.0.0'], '-1\n', 0),
                             (['check', '1.2.3'], '', 0),
                             (['check', 'invalid'], '', 2)]:
    stdout, stderr = io.StringIO(), io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(stdout), contextlib.redirect_stderr(stderr):
        assert semver.main(argv) == status
    assert stdout.getvalue() == output
    assert bool(stderr.getvalue()) == bool(status)
print('All targeted requirement checks passed.')
